data.name: Chickey Kong
data.detailed_description:
Chickey Kong: Feathered Arcade Action!

Chickey Kong is a challenging, retro-style platformer that pays homage to the great arcade classics. Step into the shoes of a fearless character, climb dizzying levels, dodge pesky flying enemies, and reach the summit in this pixel-art adventure filled with nostalgia and feathered fun.

Chaos has taken over the coop!

Chickey Kong transports you back to the golden age of gaming, where skill and reflexes were everything. Developed by SeguSoul Creations, this title recaptures the essence of 80s arcades with a fresh and funny twist.

Your mission sounds simple, but it’s anything but: you must ascend through complex structures of platforms and ladders while the environment tries to stop you. It’s not just about climbing; it’s about surviving. You’ll need to time every jump with pinpoint precision and anticipate your enemies' every move.

Can you make it to the top?

The path is riddled with danger—from buzzing flies patrolling the air with treacherous patterns to obstacles that will test your patience. Chickey Kong doesn’t hand out victories; you have to earn them jump by jump, just like in the old school.

Key Features:

  • Classic Arcade Gameplay: A control system that’s easy to learn but hard to master. Jump, climb, and dodge with just a few buttons.

  • Vertical Challenge: Levels designed to test your mental agility and reflexes. One false move and you could fall back to the start.

  • Retro Aesthetics: Enjoy a polished and colorful Pixel Art style, accompanied by sound effects that will make you feel like you're standing in front of an arcade cabinet.

  • Relentless Enemies: Learn the patterns of flies and other environmental hazards to find the perfect moment to move forward.

  • Instant Fun: No unnecessary complications. Load the game and jump straight into the action. Perfect for quick bursts or intense sessions trying to beat your high score.

Get ready to dust off your platforming skills. Chickey Kong is waiting for you.
